linkedin.text:
Your AI writes error messages like this: "Oops! Something went wrong while attempting to establish a connection."

A tired engineer at 2 AM needs this: "Connection to the database failed: the password for user 'app' was not correct. Set DB_PASSWORD to the correct value, then connect again."

The difference? ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — the controlled language aerospace has used since 1983 so mechanics cannot misread critical instructions. 🛠️

SimpleEnglish is an agent skill that forces LLMs to follow those same 53 numbered rules. No more 40-word run-ons, no more "seamlessly leverage," no more hedging with "should" and "may."

✅ 72.9% fewer STE violations measured across 6 Claude models
✅ Shorter output (saves you tokens on every generation)
✅ Works in Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and 25+ agent harnesses

One npx command installs it. Your docs, error messages, runbooks, and incident reports instantly get flat, impossible-to-misread instructions instead of AI slop. 💀

1,579 stars. MIT licensed. Benchmarked against the real Issue 9 spec, not blog summaries.

Search "AminBlg SimpleEnglish" on GitHub.

When did you last read an AI-generated doc and actually trust it?
